_note: Checker v3 rejects the same seven natural sentences as v2 (same drafts, same rules for these cases); classification unchanged. v3 sends more sentences to the reviewer and ticks fewer.

cases.why: In 'down to 9.0% of agency revenue against 14.4% year to date', 14.4% is a share compared with a share; the checker read its measure as revenue.
Same construction: '9.0% of agency revenue in the month against 14.4% year to date'.
Claude wrote a unit after a reference: the page would print '4.0 percentage points percentage points'.
'down on budget by 4.0 percentage points': the phrase 'on budget' (in line) matched before 'down on'.
Claude typed '£190,000' instead of citing the budget figure. The value is right, but typed figures are outside the contract and cannot be checked.
Claude typed '2.0' percentage points instead of citing the variance.
Second sentence: 'a month share of 9.0%' is August; the checker does not know 'month share' as a period and inherited year to date.

realSummary: one unit written twice, two figures typed instead of cited
falseSummary: two share-against-share comparisons, one 'down on budget' read as 'on budget', one 'month share' not recognised as August
